say:1:1311403001:0.text: Did I make a heart on the ice...?
say:1:1311403001:0.source_cn: 我到底有没有在冰上滑出一个漂亮的、浪漫的心型啊……

say:2:1311403002:0.text: It's so strange. I feel like I've been standing here for ages. My feet are numb. Maybe I'm just nervous...
say:2:1311403002:0.source_cn: 好奇怪，总觉得我在这里站了好久。呼，脚都站麻了。我是太...

say:3:1311403003:0.text: Don't be nervous. Forget the heart. Just go propose!
say:3:1311403003:0.source_cn: 不要紧张，别滑什么心型了，直接去求婚吧！

say:4:1311403004:0.text: Shh, keep your voice down! Don't let her hear you. My Kaya is the most beautiful woman in all of Esperia...
say:4:1311403004:0.source_cn: 嘘，小声点！别让卡娅听见……我的卡娅，全伊索米亚最美的...

say:5:1311403005:0.text: Wait... Did I say this to you before?
say:5:1311403005:0.source_cn: 呃，我总觉得我好像跟你说过这句话……
